newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to up June, July rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to up June, July rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday it was raising the margin requirements on its June and July rubber futures contracts by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Thursday.
Following the change, the margin requirement on June will be 97,750 yen, while the July margin fee will be 62,500 yen, TOCOM said.
The move is aimed at cooling overheated trade, TOCOM said in a statement. The margin fees of other rubber futures will remain unchanged at 52,500 yen, it said.
